{{Quote|Zoojoo remembers their visit well. It was days before Lord Bactra conquered our world.|[[Zoojoo]], to [[Kerra Holt]]|<ref name="Escape 2" />}}
In [[1039 BBY]],<ref name="Escape 2" /> the [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="Knight Errant">[[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']]</ref> [[Ayanos Bactra]] '''conquered''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarrassia/Legends|Sarrassia]]<ref name="Escape 2" /> in the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] and sought to exploit the world's [[Sarrassian iron/Legends|Sarrassian iron]] resources. Sarrassia subsequently became part of Bactra's holdings&mdash;the [[Bactranate]]&mdash;and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord ended religious conflict on the world between the [[Grumani Hierophant]]s and [[Spumani Crusader]]s.<ref name="Knight Errant Gazetteer">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}}</ref> Bactra's occupation of Sarrassia denied his rival Sith Lord [[Odion]] access to Sarrassia to [[Project Pandemonium|search]] for the [[Helm of Ieldis]] [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifact]] until the Bactranate's [[Invasion of the Bactranate|fall]]<ref name="Escape 2" /> in 1032 BBY.<ref name="Knight Errant" />
